experiments.verification_evidence: STATIC_AUDIT. Recomputation: macro R@10 = (50.32+56.32+59.28)/3 = 55.306667 -> 55.31 = printed; macro R@50 = (72.10+74.93+78.45)/3 = 75.160000 -> 75.16 = printed. Mean: (printed 55.31 + printed 75.16)/2 = 65.235 -> 65.24 = printed AVG.; but (unrounded macros 55.306667 + 75.160000)/2 = 65.233333 -> 65.23, which is 0.01 BELOW the printed AVG. 65.24. So the printed Mean equals the mean of the two PRINTED Average cells and does not equal the mean of the unrounded category macros. Registry records 55.31 / 75.16 / 65.24 (workbench/registry/models.yaml:311-313), matching the table. Protocol caveat: the paper states 'FashionIQ validation set' but never describes the gallery construction or reference policy; the pinned evaluator defaults to split='original-split' (workbench/third_party/INTENT/datasets.py:26) which enumerates the full validation image list (datasets.py:203-211), and masks the reference before ranking (test.py:150 sets sims[i, ...index(source_img_id)] = -10e10 before np.argsort at test.py:154). This is the best-supported reading, not something the paper states.
experiments.verification_method: Four independent routes agreeing digit-for-digit: arXiv HTML Table 2; `pdftotext -layout -f 6 -l 6 intent.pdf -` -> 'INTENT (Ours) 50.32 72.10 56.32 74.93 59.28 78.45 55.31 75.16 65.24'; rendered PDF page 6 read visually; author workbench/third_party/INTENT/figs/fiq.png. Arithmetic recomputed with Python Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP.
